markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and high reliability [F1], but the second model disagrees and neighbors are split.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 98%, Normal 1%, Invasive 1% | Strongly favors InSitu |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / OOD 1.0 | No quality flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical; concept model leans away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Typical score; failed spot check, so not a reason [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 5) · ↓ invasive · High score; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below typical here; concept model leans away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60). It is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Neighbors split (2 of 5 InSitu) and MUSK disagrees, so the top class may not hold.
- Resampling degradation (severity 3) shifts probabilities; the calibration CI is wide (ECE up to 0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 5**: confirm atypical cells stay within ducts, with no stromal breach.
2. **Region 9**: highest tile invasive risk (49%); look for infiltrating stroma.
3. **Region 7**: tile invasive risk 30%; check for invasive foci.
